plugins.name: tasks-board
plugins.description: Docked right-hand pane showing a project's TASKS.md board.

plugins.name: plan-view
plugins.description: Docked right-hand pane showing the plan Claude writes in plan mode as formatted markdown.

plugins.name: jev-compaction
plugins.description: Periodic Jev-guided compaction of long sessions: prunes stale tool calls and old message text without a built-in summary.

plugins.name: jev-skills
plugins.description: Replaces the built-in skill listing with a Jev-picked shortlist per prompt, in a way that keeps the prompt cache valid.

plugins.name: context-diet
plugins.description: Cuts repeated hook boilerplate: the caveman per-prompt reminder on every 10th prompt only, short post-compaction SessionStart texts, and a two-line caveman text for subagent workers.

plugins.name: gh-runs
plugins.description: Live band above the prompt for the GitHub Actions runs gh-watcher is tracking, with a coloured chat item when each run ends.
